## Discovery & Translational Science

* **EPAS1 loss-of-function variants drive antiangiogenic TKI resistance in high-altitude HCC** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.05.26358954)
  * Germline loss-of-function variants in *EPAS1* (encoding HIF-2α), enriched in high-altitude populations, correlate with primary resistance to antiangiogenic tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs) in hepatocellular carcinoma via a HIF-2/STC2 signaling axis.
  * Multi-cohort integration (n = 1,396) confirmed STC2 as an independent prognostic factor predicting worse overall survival (HR = 1.711, p = 0.0028).
  * Findings support combining antiangiogenic TKIs with the HIF-2 inhibitor belzutifan, alongside an AESI_score biomarker strategy currently entering prospective clinical validation.

* **MR-based AI pipeline prioritizes drug targets for lipid traits and cardiovascular disease** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.02.28.26347341)
  * A three-stage computational pipeline combines Mendelian randomization (MR) target identification, cross-cohort validation, and large-language-model drug mapping.
  * Demonstrated on atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease to filter and prioritize druggable protein targets with consistent causal directionality across external cohorts.

* **Elephant seal cells utilize iron export and lipid remodeling to resist ferroptosis** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.10.744012)
  * Endothelial cells from deep-diving elephant seals display intrinsic resistance to lipid peroxidation caused by extreme hypoxia/reoxygenation events.
  * Cytoprotection relies on high baseline expression of ACSL3, rapid induction of the iron exporter ferroportin (SLC40A1), and natural enrichment of monounsaturated fatty acids and triglycerides within lipid droplets.

* **Neuromorphic edge-AI framework enables real-time seizure prediction** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.09.22.25336341)
  * An on-chip spiking neural network deployed on the BrainChip Akida processor achieved patient-specific seizure detection and prediction without cloud transmission.
  * Outperformed standard neural network architectures in AUROC and sensitivity while significantly cutting memory usage and power consumption for closed-loop neurostimulation devices.

* **T-Rx open-source R package released for EHR prescription phenotyping** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.10.07.25336002)
  * T-Rx standardizes processing of electronic health record prescription data across UK Biobank and CPRD databases.
  * Integrates modules for strength/quantity imputation, longitudinal exposure building, and clinical phenotype mapping for pharmacoepidemiological studies.

* **Discovery of a selective PROTAC degrader targeting KRAS G12D** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42603637/)
  * Preclinical study reports the identification of a potent proteolysis-targeting chimera (PROTAC) capable of selective degradation of mutant KRAS G12D.

* **Melatonin mitigates neuropathic pain via gut-microbiota linoleic acid pathways** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42603252/)
  * In mouse models, melatonin attenuated neuropathic pain by suppressing pyroptosis through gut microbiota-mediated regulation of linoleic acid metabolism.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Biotech]** **AbCellera reports positive Phase 2 results for ABCL635** [X/BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2088644704237650410)
  * AbCellera reported positive Phase 2 clinical trial results for its therapeutic candidate ABCL635, prompting a 35% gain in share price.

* **[Biotech]** **Silence Therapeutics reports positive clinical data for divesiran** [X/BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2088644704237650410)
  * Silence Therapeutics released positive trial findings for its investigational siRNA therapy divesiran, driving a 29% stock increase.

* **Liposomal bupivacaine evaluated in hip fracture pilot trial** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42602754/)
  * A multicenter randomized pilot trial tested surgical site injections of liposomal bupivacaine to reduce postoperative narcotic consumption in patients undergoing surgery for hip fractures.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Big Pharma]** **Meta-analysis quantifies blood pressure reduction with tirzepatide and semaglutide** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42603240/)
  * A systematic review and meta-analysis confirmed that dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist tirzepatide (**[Big Pharma]** Eli Lilly) and GLP-1 receptor agonist semaglutide (**[Big Pharma]** Novo Nordisk) deliver statistically significant reductions in blood pressure.
  * The findings validate systemic cardiovascular and hemodynamic benefits alongside metabolic parameters in clinical populations.

* **[Biotech]** **Tenax Therapeutics shares fall 90% following Phase 3 trial failure** [X/BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2088644704237650410)
  * Tenax Therapeutics reported negative top-line results from its Phase 3 clinical program, leading to a 90% single-day drop in stock price.

## Business & Strategy

* **[Biotech]** **Innate Pharma advances lacutamab toward Phase 3** [X/BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2088644704237650410)
  * Innate Pharma announced plans to move its anti-KIR3DL2 antibody lacutamab into Phase 3 trials, sending shares up 28%.

* **[Biotech]** **Mereo BioPharma signs licensing agreement for alvelestat** [X/BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2088644704237650410)
  * Mereo BioPharma secured an option and licensing deal for its oral neutrophil elastase inhibitor alvelestat, resulting in a 15% share gain.

* **[Biotech]** **Tang Capital takes 7.1% stake in Capricor Therapeutics** [X/BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2088688271303815389)
  * Tang Capital disclosed a 7.1% equity stake in Capricor Therapeutics.

* **[Biotech]** **PDS Biotech refocuses development pipeline on PDS0301** [X/BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2088644704237650410)
  * PDS Biotechnology shares dropped 64% following a strategic reprioritization centered on its antibody-interleukin-12 fusion protein PDS0301.

* **[Biotech]** **Sionna Therapeutics falls 91% following pipeline update** [X/BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2088644704237650410)
  * Top-line results across Sionna Therapeutics' primary drug development programs drove a 91% single-day decline in share value.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Oral GLP-1 prescription trends highlight Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly competition** [X/BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2088652284032893074)
  * Weekly prescription volume tracking illustrates ongoing commercial market share dynamics between Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly in the oral GLP-1 space.

**Worth watching:** Prospective trial data (2023-ZJ-786) evaluating the *EPAS1* genotype-stratified combination of antiangiogenic TKIs with the HIF-2 inhibitor belzutifan in high-altitude hepatocellular carcinoma cohorts.

- Economics
    - [The Insane US-Japan Currency Bailout](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yh18YXKMk3g) -- Patrick Boyle
        - In July 2026, the US Treasury executed its first currency market intervention since 1998 to support the Japanese yen.
        - Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent conducted the trade unconventionally by selling euros instead of US dollars without informing the European Central Bank (ECB).
        - The intervention's core objective was to protect US borrowing costs during a period when 30-year Treasury yields climbed to their highest levels since 2001.
        - The analysis examines the mechanics of the yen carry trade, the FIMA repo facility, and Bessent's bet on falling interest rates amid the potential erosion of the dollar's exorbitant privilege.
